_comment: Candidate DEX-AMM deployments on the Messari standardized schema. ONE query shape (query.graphql) runs against every entry — that reuse is the standardization payoff. IDs resolved from messari/subgraphs deployment/deployment.json (the registry the Subgraph MCP searches) and probed live: uniswap-v2 3s behind head, sushiswap 15s, curve 10s; balancer-v2 kept as fixture (public deployment returns bad-indexer errors). `identity` documents what the deployment's Swap.from actually holds (VERIFIED in messari mapping code): uniswap-v2-forks + curve assign the event's sender param = the pool's direct caller (an EOA-signed bot IS itself; routed retail lumps under the router and dilutes below threshold); balancer-forks assigns event.transaction.from (the signing EOA). `schemaNotes` records per-deployment drift the fetcher auto-degrades around.

venues.name: Uniswap V2
venues.schemaNotes: deployment omits USD pricing (amountInUSD=0) — swaps still mark and confirm cross-venue reputation (venuesActive), but carry no notional weight in venue/market scores

venues.name: Curve Finance
venues.schemaNotes: deployment predates Swap.reserveAmounts — fetcher strips the field; scorer falls back to trade-implied reference mid

venues.name: Balancer V2
venues.schemaNotes: public deployment currently unservable (bad indexers, no attestation) — falls back to fixture
